description:
Winterkongress 2026 Schedule
Winterkongress of digital society on February 20 and 21 2026
Winterkongress is a co-production of Rote Fabrik and digital society. We thank all supporters cordially!
https://winterkongress.ch/2026/
App features
• View program by day and rooms (side by side)
• Custom grid layout for smartphones (try landscape mode) and tablets
• Read detailed descriptions (speaker names, start time, room name, links, ...) of sessions
• Search and filter through all sessions
• Add sessions to favourites list
• Export favourites list
• Setup alarms for individual sessions
• Add sessions to your personal calendar
• Share a website link to an session with others
• Keep track of program changes
• Automatic program updates (configurable in settings)
• Automatically open sessions from web links
🤝 You can help to translate the app at:
https://crowdin.com/project/eventfahrplan
💡 Questions regarding the content can only be answered by the content team
of digital society. This app simply offers a way to consume and personalise
the conference schedule.
💣 Bug reports are very welcome. It would be awesome if you can describe how
to reproduce the particular error. Please use the GitHub issue tracker
https://github.com/DigitaleGesellschaft/EventFahrplan/issues.
🎨 Digital society. Design by studio kollygujer
